items.title: Stock Radar: Sona BLW stock breaks out from 11-month consolidation to hit fresh 52-week high; time to buy?
items.description: Sona BLW Precision Forgings stock has broken out from an 11-month consolidation. This move pushed the stock to a fresh 52-week high. Experts suggest buying the stock for a target of Rs 661 in the next 1-2 months. The stock shows strong momentum indicators, indicating a positive trend shift and potential for further upside.

items.title: Tata Elxsi shares in focus as Q4 net profit jumps 28%, revenue up 9% to Rs 994 crore
items.description: Tata Elxsi reported a strong Q4FY26 performance with a sharp rise in net profit and steady revenue growth. Margins remained healthy, supported by deal wins and segmental strength in media and transportation. Sequential improvement was robust, reflecting improving momentum and continued traction across key verticals and strategic business segments.

items.title: LIC Housing Finance among 5 stocks flashing bullish signals, hinting at a possible uptrend
items.description: On April 21, in the Nifty200 segment, five stocks appeared on the ‘White Marubozu’ bullish scanner, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period and the closing price is the highest.Represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and a small or nonexistent lower shadow, it indicates strong buying pressure throughout the session. Traders interpret it as a signal that buyers were in control from the opening to the closing, often using such patterns for informed decisions about future price movements in financial markets.

items.title: Karur Vysya Bank among 5 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: Five stocks from the Nifty500 segment that gained over 3% were identified using the RSI Trending Up scan on April 21, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from below. “RSI trending up” indicates that the Relative Strength Index (RSI) is rising, suggesting strengthening price momentum in the stock. This may signal potential upward movement and can be used by traders to identify buying opportunities.

items.title: GIFT Nifty hints at a gap-down start. Should investors brace for another weak session?
items.description: Indian markets experienced a strong session on Tuesday, with the Nifty rising nearly 1% driven by positive global sentiment, robust Q4 earnings, and easing crude prices. Volatility also saw a significant pullback. Investors are now keenly watching the second round of US-Iran talks, with hopes for progress despite elevated tensions.

items.description: In today's trade, shares of SBI Life, Trent, Tata Investment, HCL Tech, Suzlon Energy among others will be in focus due to various news developments.

items.title: It's not just war that brought rupee down, it needs better support
items.description: The West Asia conflict has accelerated INR depreciation, necessitating a rethink of India's economic fundamentals. Short-term measures include raising domestic interest rates and equalizing onshore tax regulations for asset classes. Longer-term, building world-class universities, encouraging local tourism, and potentially redesigning the INR symbol are proposed to foster resilience and economic growth.

items.title: DSP MF sees attractive entry point in large private banks
items.description: “Without pencilling in any re-rating, large private banks present an attractive opportunity for investors today,” said DSP in a note.  “More price decline will make them more attractive.”

items.title: As FPIs continue to sell, outflows likely to rise before inflows revive
items.description: "The financial services sector has the biggest weight on benchmark Nifty; so when there is broad-based selling, banking and financial services' share in foreign selling tends to be higher," said U R Bhat, co-founder & director, Alphaniti.

items.title: Fairfax likely to buy 10% more in IIFL Capital via preferential allotment
items.description: Fairfax Financial Holdings plans to boost its stake in IIFL Capital Services. The deal is valued at approximately ₹1,000 crore. This move will see Fairfax's holding increase by about 10%. The transaction is expected to trigger an open offer under Indian regulations. Prem Watsa's firm is doubling down on its investment after thorough due diligence.

items.title: D-Street bounces as traders cover short bets ahead of peace talks
items.description: Indian markets saw significant gains on Tuesday, with the Nifty and Sensex rising over 0.9% and 1% respectively. This surge was driven by traders cutting bearish bets ahead of US-Iran peace talks and a moderation in foreign institutional selling. Technical indicators suggest a bullish outlook, with the Nifty potentially moving towards 24,800-25,000.

items.title: Life insurers log 16% premium growth in FY26 on GST relief, shift to high-margin products
items.description: India’s life insurance industry recorded a 16% rise in new business premiums to ₹4.59 lakh crore in FY26, driven by GST exemption benefits, stronger demand for regular premium policies, and a strategic shift towards higher-margin protection and long-term savings products.
